title: A payer that is the Bill To on a part sale cannot be deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with no work orders, part sales, assets or contacts of its own.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, open, billed to customer B, so customer B is the Bill To on a part sale.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Click Delete in the Confirmation window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • A "Confirmation" window asks "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with "Cancel" and "Delete".

Step 3:

  • The delete is refused with "Company with a work order cannot be deleted."
  • Customer B is not deleted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
